title: Voice leading and modes
status: First draft, written before you started Level 1. Before printing, re-tune it from your Level 4 check-in sheet and practice log: pairs, targets and tempos are best guesses.
summary: Two ways of hearing harmony from the inside. Modes: each is a major or minor scale with one note changed, made audible by a two-chord vamp — Mixolydian (major with ♭7) in Norwegian Wood, Dorian (minor with a natural 6) in She's Not There. Voice leading: move every note the shortest way, follow the 3rds and 7ths, and play three-note shell chords so a ii–V–I sounds arranged rather than strummed.
goals: Play A Lydian, Ionian, Mixolydian, Dorian, Aeolian and Phrygian at fret 5 and name the changed note in each.
Play maj7, 7 and m7 shells from roots on strings 6 and 5, and a ii–V–I with shells in C and G.
Norwegian Wood with the record, in 3/4, hook over D included.
She's Not There with the record: tight, short Am7 – D comping.
Improvise four-bar phrases over Dorian and Mixolydian vamps that land on chord tones.
song_plan: Core: **Norwegian Wood** (Song day weeks 1–2; capo 2, count in 3) and **She's Not There** (weeks 3–4); Session D plays both. Swap a core song for an alternate when you can already play it with the record, or when its hard change is still under 15 a minute after two weeks. Alternates, easiest first: *On Some Faraway Beach* (slow; F barre → A → D), *Cortez the Killer* (a long Em7 – D5 – Am11 vamp in double drop D — a preview of Level 6), *Ping Pong* (barre m7s at 168 in C♯ Dorian).

exit_criteria: Benchmarks 1–5 at target in two Session Ds in a row.
Norwegian Wood with the record, no stops, hook included.
She's Not There with the record, no stops, comping short and even.
ii–V–I with shells starting from any root on string 5, within ten seconds (five roots).
Over each vamp (A – G, Am7 – D), eight bars of phrases that each end on R, 3 or 5.
stuck: Not every box ticked after 6 weeks? Move on anyway. Keep one song from this level (a core song or an easier alternate) as a 5-minute play-through in Level 6's Session D, and open every Level 6 Session A primer with your weakest pair until it reaches target.
skip_ahead: Pass every benchmark cold (first attempt, no practice that day) in week 1's Session D? Go straight to Level 6.

drills.title: One-minute changes
drills.instructions: Timer at 1:00. One down-strum per chord, change, strum the other, as fast as you can while staying clean. Count clean landings only. Two rounds per pair; write the better count.

drills.title: Air shapes
drills.instructions: Hand off the neck. Form the whole shape an inch above the strings, land all fingers at once, strum, check every string, lift. Ten per shape.

drills.title: Place and lift
drills.instructions: Fret the shape, relax until the fingers just touch, press again. Twenty presses, one per click at 60, no strumming.

drills.title: Anchor hunt
drills.instructions: Before a new pair, say what stays (anchor), what slides along its string (guide) and what jumps. Then ten changes keeping anchors down. This level: D → D/C♯ → C = the D shape's fingers lift one at a time while the bass walks; shells = the root finger stays, only the 3rd or 7th moves; ii–V–I shells = each chord's 7th falls a half step to the next chord's 3rd.

drills.title: Change loop
drills.instructions: Strum chord 1 once, change, strum chord 2 once, stop, reset. Ten clean in a row; a miss sets the count back to zero.

drills.title: Tempo ladder
drills.instructions: One chord per bar, four down-strums (or the song's figure). Start where it is perfect (try 50). Three clean passes: +4 bpm. A miss: −8 bpm. Write the top clean tempo in today's blank.

drills.title: Eyes closed
drills.instructions: Make the change without looking; open your eyes after landing to check. Ten times.

drills.title: Song loop
drills.instructions: Loop the two bars around the hard change in the song's own rhythm, 10 bpm under this week's tempo. Then add a bar either side. Then the whole section.

drills.title: Random pairs
drills.instructions: Write the 14 chord names from the chord page on scraps. Draw two, do one-minute changes, write the pair and count on the back of the sheet. Draw again.

drills.title: Shell families
drills.instructions: **6-string shells at fret 3:** Gmaj7 3x44xx → G7 3x34xx → Gm7 3x33xx. **5-string shells at fret 3:** Cmaj7 x324xx → C7 x323xx → Cm7 x313xx. One per bar at 60; say “7th drops”, then “3rd drops”. Then move both families to fret 5 (A and D).

drills.title: ii–V–I with shells
drills.instructions: **In C:** Dm7 x535xx → G7 3x34xx → Cmaj7 x324xx. **In G:** Am7 5x55xx → D7 x545xx → Gmaj7 3x44xx. One per bar at 70. Each chord's 7th falls a half step to the next chord's 3rd — hear it.

drills.title: Guide tones
drills.instructions: Only the 3rd and 7th of each chord, on strings 4 and 3, through Dm7 – G7 – Cmaj7: F + C (frets 3, 5) → F + B (3, 4) → E + B (2, 4). One per bar. Then sing the line that moves.

drills.title: Brightness ladder
drills.instructions: Strike the open A string every bar as a drone. At fret 5 play, up and down once each: Lydian (♯4) → Ionian → Mixolydian (♭7) → Dorian (♭3, ♭7) → Aeolian (♭3, ♭6, ♭7) → Phrygian (♭2 too). Ionian = Mixolydian with the ♭7 raised a fret; Phrygian = Aeolian with the 2 lowered a fret. Say the changed note each time.

drills.title: Modal vamp
drills.instructions: Loop the vamp four beats per chord and play four-note phrases with the matching position, ending each phrase on R, 3 or 5 of the chord under it. **Mixolydian:** A x02220 – G 320003. **Lydian:** A – B x24442. **Dorian:** Am7 x02010 – D xx0232. **Aeolian:** Am – F. Strum one bar, play one bar.

drills.title: Scale in 3rds
drills.instructions: In this week's position play pairs a 3rd apart to the top and back down. Quarters at 60, then eighths.

drills.title: Make something
drills.instructions: Pick Dorian or Mixolydian and any root. Make its two-chord vamp, then a four-bar melody over it that starts and ends on chord tones. Write the vamp and the melody's first notes in Notes.

Shell chords: useful in your own songs, or a classroom exercise?

sessions.name: A
sessions.title: Chord day
sessions.focus: New shapes and this week's three pairs (week plan, column 1). Pair 1 is the hard one.

blocks.title: Primer: today's shapes
blocks.instructions: Shell families at 60 (1 min each). Then air shapes ×10 on both chords of pair 1. Carried a weak pair from Level 4? Change-loop it for the last minute.

blocks.title: Pair 1: the full recipe
blocks.instructions: Anchor hunt (say what stays, slides, jumps) → slow motion ×5 → change loop to 10 clean → tempo ladder from 50, one chord per bar. A chain of chords? Ladder the whole chain. Stop at the clock.

blocks.title: Pairs 2 and 3
blocks.instructions: Change loop to 10 clean on each, then one-minute changes: two rounds each. Write the better count.

blocks.title: ii–V–I with shells
blocks.instructions: In C, then in G (frets on the drill page), one per bar. Stop and listen when the 7th falls to the 3rd.

blocks.title: Fretboard: guide tones
blocks.instructions: 3rds and 7ths only, strings 4 and 3, through Dm7 – G7 – Cmaj7. Name the two notes of each chord.

blocks.title: Song: put pair 1 back in
blocks.instructions: In this week's song section: song loop on the two bars with pair 1, then the section ×2 at this week's tempo.

blocks.title: Log
blocks.instructions: Log page: tick A, write the minutes. In Notes: the change that felt worst today.

sessions.name: B
sessions.title: Fretboard day
sessions.focus: Modes as colours: one position, one changed note, one vamp (week plan, column 2).

blocks.title: Primer
blocks.instructions: Air shapes ×10 on the two chords of pair 1, then the change with eyes closed ×10.

blocks.title: The changed note
blocks.instructions: This week's mode against its parent: play the A major (or A natural minor) position, then the mode, and find the one note that moved. Mark it on the scale page.

blocks.title: This week's mode
blocks.instructions: Weeks 1 Mixolydian, 2 Lydian, 3 Dorian, 4 the brightness ladder. Over the open A drone. Quarters at 60, then eighths on the tempo ladder; weeks 1–3 also in 3rds.

blocks.title: The vamp
blocks.instructions: This week's vamp from the drill page: strum one bar, play one bar of the mode, ending every phrase on R, 3 or 5.

blocks.title: Song by numbers: She's Not There
blocks.instructions: A Dorian: Am7 = i7, D = IV (major — the Dorian giveaway), F = ♭VI, A = I (major). Play the verse ×3 at this week's SNT tempo, short and staccato; then the same i7 – IV vamp in E Dorian: Em7 – A.

blocks.title: Log
blocks.instructions: Log page: tick B, write the minutes. Notes: what on the fretboard is still slow.

sessions.name: C
sessions.title: Song day
sessions.focus: Longest song block: isolate this week's hard change (pair 1), then play the section and the song in time. Weeks 1–2 Norwegian Wood (capo 2, 3/4), weeks 3–4 She's Not There.

blocks.title: Primer
blocks.instructions: Place-and-lift ×20 and air shapes ×10 on the two chords of pair 1.

blocks.title: The hard change
blocks.instructions: Change loop to 10 clean, then tempo ladder one chord per bar from 50.

blocks.title: Fretboard: which mode?
blocks.instructions: Read this week's song. Name its home chord and the one chord that gives away the mode (Norwegian Wood: C in D = ♭VII, Mixolydian; She's Not There: D in Am = IV, Dorian). Play that pair as a vamp for a minute.

blocks.title: This week's song
blocks.instructions: Song loop round the hard change (5 min). The week's section ×3 at this week's tempo. Then the whole form without stopping — fumble through. Weeks 3–4: the last 5 minutes with the record.

blocks.title: The other core song
blocks.instructions: Once through at this week's tempo for it. Mark any bar that broke and give it one song loop.

blocks.title: Log
blocks.instructions: Log page: tick C, write the minutes. Notes: the bar where you stopped, if any.

sessions.name: D
sessions.title: Mix and measure
sessions.focus: Short versions of everything, the benchmarks with numbers, one review from Level 4, and five minutes of your own music.

blocks.title: Primer
blocks.instructions: Air shapes ×5 on every chord in benchmarks 1–3. The tests are taken cold.

blocks.title: Benchmarks
blocks.instructions: One-minute changes, one round each: **2** Am7 ↔ D · **3** Am7 ↔ F. Tempo ladder from 60 for **1** the ii–V–I shells, **4** D → D/C♯ → C → G → D and **5** the brightness ladder in eighths. Write all five numbers in the log.

blocks.title: Review from Level 4
blocks.instructions: C → C♯°7 → Dm → G7, two beats each (1 min), then Something's line cliché once, then one-minute changes on C7 ↔ F — or the pair you carried from Level 4.

blocks.title: Songs, measured
blocks.instructions: Norwegian Wood, then She's Not There — with the record from week 3, at this week's tempo before that. Write benchmarks 6 and 7 in the log.

blocks.title: Make something
blocks.instructions: Dorian or Mixolydian, any root: a two-chord vamp, then a four-bar melody over it ending on chord tones. Write the keeper in Notes.

blocks.title: Log and exit check
blocks.instructions: Tick D in the log. Tick any exit box you passed today. Week 6 or all boxes ticked? Fill in the check-in sheet.
